 Election 2026 
 Photo gallery: Scenes from Election Day
 By 
 Joan von Kampen 
 - 
 November 4, 2026 7:41 pm 
 Voters fill out ballots and check in with election workers at a polling place in Lincoln, Neb., Tuesday, Nov. 3, 2026. Tables and voting booths fill the room as neighbors exercise their right to vote. (Photo by Michelle Montenegro/Nebraska News Service)
 Nebraska Examiner reporters and student journalists from the University of Nebraska-Lincoln and University of Nebraska Omaha captured these moments Tuesday at polling places and candidates’ events.
 Lincoln residents line up to vote on Tuesday, Nov. 3, 2026 at the Sandhills Publishing Building. in Lincoln, Neb. (Fisher Madsen/Nebraska News Service/) Waverly South residents Eli Saenz and Brooke Saenz vote across from each other at the Waverly Community Center on Tuesday, Nov. 3, 2026, in Waverly, Nebraska. (Photo by Tyson Peters/Nebraska News Service) Poll worker Kay Siebler reads a local newspaper during a lull in voting on Tuesday, Nov. 3, 2026, at The Sheldon Museum of Art in Lincoln, Nebraska. (Photo by Annabel Hall/Nebraska News Service) An attendee signs in at the Lancaster County Democrats watch party on Tuesday, Nov. 3, 2026, in Lincoln, Neb. (Photo by Ryan Malvey for Nebraska Examiner) Attendees hug as they hear results during the Lancaster County Democrats watch party on Tuesday, Nov. 3, 2026, in Lincoln, Neb. (Photo by Ryan Malvey for Nebraska Examiner) Nebraska Legislative District 2 Democrat candidate Caitlin Knutson is consoled during the Lancaster County Democrats watch party on Tuesday, Nov. 3, 2026, in Lincoln, Neb. (Photo by Ryan Malvey for Nebraska Examiner) Democratic candidate Chris Backemeyer converses with attendees during his watch party at Bin 105 Quality WInes on Tuesday, Nov. 3, 2026, in Lincoln. (Photo by Emma DeShon for Nebraska Examiner) Brinker Harding poses with a guitar at his watch party Nov. 3. He lost his bid for 2nd Congressional District to Democrat Denise Powell. (Photo by Chase Zagurski for Nebraska Examiner) U.S. Sen. Deb Fischer speaks at Brinker Harding's watch party Nov. 3. He lost his bid for 2nd Congressional District to Democrat Denise Powell. (Photo by Chase Zagurski for Nebraska Examiner) Denise Powell greets supporters at her watch party turned victory in Omaha-based 2nd Congressional District. The Nov. 3 event was in downtown Omaha at the Hilton at 10th and Cass Streets. (Photo by Ailyn Adame for Nebraska Examiner) Supporter at Denise Powell watch party turned victory celebration in Omaha-based 2nd Congressional District. (Photo by Ailyn Adame for Nebraska Examiner) Democratic gubernatorial candidate Lynne Walz of Fremont, a former state senator, addresses supporters during her election night watch party on Nov. 3, 2026, in Omaha, Nebraska. (Photo by Chase Zagurski for Nebraska Examiner) Nebraska Gov. Jim Pillen greets supporters at the start of his election night watch party on Nov. 3, 2026, in Lincoln, Nebraska. (Photo by Zach Wendling/Nebraska Examiner) Nebraska Gov. Jim Pillen, center, with first lady Suzanne Pillen, poses with his reelection campaign team on Nov. 4, 2026, in Lincoln, Nebraska, shortly after declaring victory. (Photo by Zach Wendling/Nebraska Examiner)
